nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I've got a weak signal out in the Suburb Ruins. A handheld. Someone keeps keying it and not saying anything.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: They're in a house. I think they're hurt. And the Husks around them... aren't walking. They're just standing there. In the fog.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Why would they stand still?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Because something's still moving inside. They're waiting.

choices.text: Why do you care who it is?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Good. Take a med-kit, or bandages at least. They won't walk on their own.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Husks don't set traps. Husks don't do anything new. That's what bothers me.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Because the handheld's on a caravan band. Whoever it is, they've got friends with trucks.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Fog's heavy. Use Lookout. Throw a flare if you have one. And when you move them, move fast.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Juniper sits by the fire with her leg up, wrapped in your bandages. Pell watches her like she fell out of the sky.)

nodes.speaker: juniper
nodes.text: My cart's by your gate. Take it. It's a cart, not a gift. I'll want it back someday.

nodes.speaker: juniper
nodes.text: Marrow runs the Long Haul. Four trucks, freight roads, trades with anyone who doesn't shoot first. He'll be here in two days. He'll want to thank you.

choices.text: What were you doing out there alone?

nodes.speaker: juniper
nodes.text: Everything. Fuel, parts, guns, plans. He says the road's free. It'll kill you, but it's free.

nodes.speaker: juniper
nodes.text: Scouting a way round the Linked. There isn't one anymore. They're further out than last year.

nodes.speaker: juniper
nodes.text: Here. Plans for a bicycle cart, and a manual. Marrow says always pay in paper. Paper doesn't run out.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The handheld's gone quiet.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Her name was Juniper. It's written on the inside of the case. She rode for a caravan.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: They'll come looking. When they do... tell them the truth. It's all you've got.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Four trucks pull up outside the fence, engines ticking. A big man in a sheepskin collar climbs down and takes his goggles off.)

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Abel Marrow. You found my outrider. That puts me in your debt, and I hate being in anybody's debt.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: So here's how we fix that. I come by every ten days. You trade fair, I trade fair. First visit, I'm generous.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Good. Everything's for sale except the road. The road's free.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Fuel, parts, and a few plans I'm not supposed to have. A bike's two wheels, a prayer and a muffler. We'll talk.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: And a debt in people gets paid in people. Hollis has driven for me eleven years and wants a roof that doesn't move. Feed them, they'll work.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Count the people. Then count the cargo. In that order. See you in ten.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Four trucks outside the fence. Nobody climbs down for a long time.)

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Abel Marrow. You went in after Juniper. I heard.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: I'm not going to say thank you. I'm going to trade with you, because the road's the road. But the prices are the prices for a while.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: She was nineteen. Write that down somewhere.
